subject.title: fix: compaction usage guards and agent-loop turn correctness

question: Should `AgentOptions.prepareNextTurnWithContext` become a permanent exported OpenClaw plugin API, aligned with the upstream agent-core hook, or should the session wrapper carry this turn context through an internal seam?
rationale: Either implementation can restore per-turn session state, but choosing an exported hook creates a durable plugin compatibility contract that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve the additive hook
options.body: Keep the upstream-aligned context-aware hook, document its precedence over `prepareNextTurn`, and add focused public-surface compatibility coverage.

options.title: Keep the seam internal
options.body: Remove the exported API addition and pass the required turn context through an OpenClaw-owned session/runtime boundary instead.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive hook
recommendation.body: Keep the upstream-aligned context-aware hook, document its precedence over `prepareNextTurn`, and add focused public-surface compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior merged work and the current branch place this person closest to the agent/session ownership and plugin-surface tradeoff.
